claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled viability screen, UNC0321 is expected to be largely inactive because its picomolar G9a inhibition does not translate into cellular potency due to poor membrane permeability, and no alternative cytotoxic mechanism is evident.
